s: strI, (BErava + NIp .) cAmuRqA । yaTA, “cAmuRqA carcikA carmmamuRqA mArjArakarRikA । karRamowI mahAganDA BEravI ca kapAlinI ॥” iti hemacandraH । 2 । 120 ॥ BEravIviSezA yaTA । tripuraBEravI 1 sampatpradA BEravI 2 kOleSaBEravI 3 sakalasidDidA BEravI 4 BayaviDvaMsinI BEravI 5 cEtanyaBEravI 6 kAmeSvarI BEravI 7 zawkUwA BEravI 8 nityA BEravI 9 rudraBEravI 10 BuveneSvarI BEravI 11 tripurabAlA BEravI 12 navakUwA BEravI 13 annapUrRA BEravI 14 । AsAM mantrA yaTA, -- aTa tripuraBEravI । “viyadBfguhutASasTo BOtiko binduSeKaraH । viyattadAdikendrAgnisTitaM vAmAkzibindumat ॥ AkASaBfguvahnisTo manuH sargenduKaRqavAn । paYcakUwAtmikA vidyA vedyA tripuraBEravI ॥” 1 ॥ aTa sampatpradA BEravI । yaTAsO tripurA bAlA taTA tripUraBEravI । sampatpradA nAma tasyAH SfRu nirmmalamAnase ॥ SivacandrO vahnisaMsTO vAgBavaM tadanantaram । kAmarAjaM taTA devi ! SivacandrAnvitaM tataH ॥ pfTvIbIjAntavahnyAwyaM tArttIyaM SfRu vallaBe ! । SaktibIje maheSAni ! SivavahnI niyojayet ॥ kumAryyAH parameSAni ! hitvA sargantu bEndavam । tripurA BEravI devI mahAsampatpradA priye ! ॥ 2 ॥ aTa kOleSaBEravI । sampatpradABEravIvadvidDi kOleSaBEravIm । hasAdyA sEva deveSi ! trizu bIjezu pArbbati ! । iyantu saharAdyA syAt pUjADyAnAdikaM taTA ॥ 3 ॥ aTa sakalasidDidA BEravI । etasyA eva vidyAyA Adyante rePavarjite । tadeyaM parameSAni ! nAmnA sakalasidDidA । sampatpradABEravIvat DyAnapUjAdikaM taTA ॥ 4 ॥ aTa BayaviDvaMsinI BEravI । sampatpradA BEravI Adyante reParahitA cettadA BayaviDvaMsinI BEravI Bavati । dakziRAmUrttO taTAdarSanAt । pUjAdikantu sampatpradAvat ॥ 5 ॥ aTa cEtanyaBEravI । “vAgaBavaM bIjamuccAryya jIvaprARasamanvitam । sakalA BuvaneSAnI dvitIyaM bIjamudDftam ॥ jIvaM prARaM vahnisaMsTaM Sakrasvarasamanvitam । visargAQyaMmaheSAni ! vidyA trElokyamAtfkA ॥” fzyAdinyAsaH । Sirasi dakziRAmUrttaye fzaye namaH । muKe paNkticCandase namaH । hfdi cEtanyaBEravyE devatAyE namaH ॥ 6 ॥ aTa kAmeSvarI BEravI । “kAmeSvarI ca rudrArRA pUrvvasiMhAsane sTitA । etasyA eva vidyAyA bIjadvayamudAhftam ॥ tadante parameSAni ! nityaklinne madadrave । etasyA eva tArttIyaM rudrArRA parameSvari ! ॥ 7 ॥ aTa zawkUwA BEravI । qAkinI rAkiRI bIje lAkinI kAkinIyugam । SAkinI hAkinI bIje Ahftya surasundari ! ॥ AdyamEkArasaMyuktamanyadIkAramaRqitam । SakrasvarAnvitaM devi ! tArttIyaM bIjamAliKet । bindunAdakalAkrAntaM tritayaM SElasamBave ! ॥ 8 ॥ aTa nityA BEravI । etasyA eva vidyAyAH zaqvarRAn kramaSaH sTitAn । viparItAn vada prOQe ! vidyeyaM BogamokzadA । nyAsapUjAdikaM sarvvamasyAH pUrvvavadAcaret ॥ 9 ॥ aTa rudraBEravI । SivacandrO mAdanAntaM PAntaM vahnisamanvitam । SaktiBinnaM bindunAdakalAQyaM vAgBavaM priye ! ॥ sampatpradAyA BEravyAH kAmarAjaM tadeva hi । sadASivasya bIjantu mahAsiMhAsanasya ca । ezA vidyA maheSAni ! varRituMnEva Sakyate ॥ 10 aTa BuvaneSvarI BEravI । hasAdyaM vAgBavaYcAdyaM hasakAnte sureSvari ! । BUbIjaM BuvaneSAnI dbitIyaM bIjamudDftam । SivacandrO maheSAni ! BuvaneSI ca BEravI ॥ 11 ॥ aTa tripurabAlA BEravI । aDaro bindunAmAdyaM brahmendrasTaH SaSI yutaH । dvitIyaM BfgusargAQyo manustArttIyamIritam । ezA bAleti viKyAtA trElokyavaSakAriRI ॥ 12 aTa navakUwA bAlA । bAlAbIjatrayaM devi ! kUwatrayaM navAkzarI । viyatkUWatrayaM devi ! BEravyA navakUWakam ॥ 13 ॥ ayAnnapUrRA BEravI । praRavaM BuvaneSAni ! SrIbIjaM kAmabIjakam । hfdante Bagavatyante mAheSvaripadaM tataH । annapUrRe WayugalaM vidyeyaM viMSadakzarI ॥ 14 ॥” iti tantrasAre BEravImantraparicCedaH ॥ rAgiRIviSezaH । sA ca BEravarAgasya patnI । yaTA, -- “BEravI kOSikI cEva BAzA velAbalI taTA । vaNgAlI ceti rAgiRyo BEravasyEva vallaBAH ॥” matAntare mAlavarAgasya patnI । yaTA, -- DAnasI mAlasI cEva rAmakIrI ca sinDuqA । ASAvarI BEravI ca mAlavasya priyA imAH ॥” asyA DyAnaM yaTA, -- “sarovarasTA sPawikasya mandire saroruhEH SaNkaramarccayantI । tAlaprayogapratibadDagItirgOrItanUrnArada BEravIyam ॥” asyA gAnasamayaH pUrvvAhRakAlaH । yaTA, -- “viBAzA lalitA cEva kAmodI paWamaYjarI । rAmakIrI rAmakelI veloyArI ca gujjarI ॥ deSakArI ca SuBagA paYcamI ca gaqA tuqI । BEravI cATa kOmArI rAgiRyo daSa paYca ca । etAH pUrvvAhRakAle tu gIyante gAyanottamEH ॥” iti saNgItadAmodaraH ॥ * ॥ hanUmanmate ezA sampUrRajAtiH । asyAH saptasvaravinyAsakramaH maDyamapaYcamaDEvatanizAdazaqjarzaBagAnDArAntaH । asyA gfhaM maDyamasvaraH । SaradftO praBAte asyA gAnasamayaH । rAgamAlAyAM asyAH svarUpam । alpavayaskA । surUpA । sunetrA । vistAravadanA । piNgalakeSA । komalANgI । raktavarRA । SvetavasanA । galaSoBitacampakamAlA । praPullapadmayuktaparvvataguhAyAM SivapUjAparAyaRA । tatra maYjIravAdakA gAyanti ca ॥ * ॥ kallinATasomeSvaraBaratamatezvevam ॥

a: भैरव — a. (वी f.) [भीरोरिदं अण्] 1 Terrible, frightful, horrible, formidable; U. 5. 6. --2 Miserable. --3 Relating to Bhairava. --वः 1 A form of Śiva (of which {8} kinds are enumerated). --2 The sentiment of terror (भयानक). --3 Fear, terror. --4 N. of a musical mode (राग) calculated to excite emotions of fear or terror. --वी 1 A form of the goddess Durgā. --2 N. of a Rāgiṇī in the Hindu musical system. --3 A girl of 12 or a young girl representing the goddess Durgā at the Durga festival. --वं Terror, horror. --Comp. --ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu (or Śiva ?); so भैरवतर्जकः --यातना a sort of purificatory torment inflicted by Bhairava of Benares on those who die there, to make their spirits fit for absorption into the Supreme Spirit.

k.v: हासो हास्यं च बीभत्सं विकृतं त्रिष्विदं द्वयम्. विस्मयोऽद्भुतमाश्चर्यं चित्रमप्यथ भैरवम्.।

s: klI, (Bezajameveti । Bezaja + “anantAvasaTetihaBezajAY YyaH .” 5 । 4 । 23 । iti YyaH .) OzaDam । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 50 ॥ (asya paryyAyo yaTA, -- “BEzajyaM BezajaYcAyurdravyamagadamOzaDam ॥” iti vEdyakaratnamAlAyAm ॥ “tadeva yuktaM BEzajyaM yadArogyAya kalpate .” iti carake sUtrasTAne dvitIye'DyAye ॥)
v: na॰ BizajaH karma Bezaja--svArTe vA zyaY । 1 Ozape Bizajo'patyaM gargA॰ yaY । 2 Bizajo'patye puMstrI॰ ।
m: भैषज्य m. patr. fr. भिषज् or भिषज, g. गर्गादि (Kāś.)
भैषज्य n. curativeness, healing efficacy, VS.
a partic. ceremony performed as a remedy for sickness, Kauś.
any remedy, drug or medicine (‘against’ gen.), ŚBr.; Suśr.
the administering of medicines &c., MW.
a: भैषज्यं — [भिषजः कर्म, भेषज-स्वार्थे वा ष्यञ्] 1 Administering medicines, medical treatment. --2 A medicament, medicine, drug. --3 Healing power, curativeness.
